note: Known fail: the server quotes the 07:00 forecast (proactive.HEAT_HOUR) whatever hour the runner usually starts, so for an evening or midday runner the heads-up states the wrong hour's heat. Follow-up: forecast at the usual start hour (derivable from runs.start_utc).
